lead.signin: Sign in with your e-mail and password.
lead.register: We mail you a confirmation link.
lead.forgot: We mail you a reset link.

help.signin: Same address via Google or password = one account. A new e-mail account works after you confirm the mailed link.
help.register: At least {min} characters; common passwords are refused. We mail a link valid 24 h; until you open it the account cannot sign in.
help.forgot: If an account uses this address we mail a reset link (24 h, one use). Also sets a password for a Google-only account.
help.reset: Setting a new password signs out every other session.

info.emailConfirmed: E-mail confirmed — sign in with your password.
info.checkConfirmation: Check your inbox for the confirmation link.
info.checkConfirmationReturn: Check your inbox and open the confirmation link — it brings you back here. Then sign in to finish connecting the app.
info.checkReset: Check your inbox for the reset link.
info.passwordChanged: Password changed — sign in with the new one.
